description: Live safety profile of an SPL token: decimals, supply, freeze and mint authority status, a risk level (HIGH when a freeze authority exists, so holders can be frozen), and the top 10 holders. Use it before buying or recommending an unfamiliar token. Cached 60 seconds. Example: {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

mint.description: Token mint address: base58, 32-44 characters (required). Pass the mint, not a ticker symbol.

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

name: token_profile
